description.zh: 连接后可检索文物数据库（search_relics）、知识库语义检索（search_movable_relics）及甲骨文单字检索（search_oracle_bone_character）。鉴权由平台级统一 API Key 托管注入请求头，无需手动配置。
description.en: Provides relic database structured search (search_relics), knowledge base semantic search (search_movable_relics), and oracle bone script character lookup (search_oracle_bone_character). Authentication is handled by platform-level API key injection—no manual configuration required.
